sn45.7:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn45.7:2.2: kissa nu kho etaṃ bhante, adhivacanaṃ
sn45.7:3.1: evaṃ vutte so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn45.7:3.3: katamannu kho bhante, amataṃ, katamo amatagāmīmaggoti?
sn45.7:3.4: yo so bhikkhu rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo
sn45.7:3.6: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo amatagāmīmaggo. seyyathidaṃ:
